purpose: Gold-standard CORRECT state for the multilingual (EN/TR/DE subdirectory) fixture.

checks.desc: hreflang alternates (en/tr/de) + x-default on every locale page
Correct lang attribute per locale (tr page lang=tr, de page lang=de)
Localized unique <title> + meta description per locale
Self-referencing canonical per locale page
Bidirectional language switcher; no orphan locale (DE)
/llms.txt present, covering all locales
AI-readable summary per locale in that locale's language
Full translation parity (no mixed-language half-translations)
/ai-agents.json present
Citation-ready factual paragraphs per locale
Organization with stable @id + sameAs on all locales
inLanguage set per locale page schema
Schema present on TR and DE pages (not EN-only)
WebPage w/ translationOfWork or consistent localized @id strategy
LocalBusiness/ContactPoint per office (London/Istanbul/Berlin)
Optimized hero image with dimensions (shared across locales)
Webfont not display:block; subset covers TR/DE diacritics
Below-the-fold media lazy-loaded
No render-blocking third-party resources
Reserved dimensions, no layout shift

scoring.note: Each category has 5 checks x 5 pts = 25. Full points when detected AND correct action; half when detected only; zero when missed.
